description: Decode a paw-ned2 team build blob (the 'pwnd0001...>...<' format shared on PvXwiki team pages and by the paw-ned2 tool) into its individual builds: player/hero label, description, and each skill bar fully decoded. Whitespace and line wraps in the pasted blob are tolerated. For a single (non-team) build code, use decode_template instead.

pwnd.description: The full pwnd blob, starting with 'pwnd000'

name: decode_pawned_team

builds.description: One entry per team slot, in blob order

build.description: Decoded bar (absent if decoding failed). Same shape as decode_template's output.

label.description: Slot name shown in paw-ned2 (Player, Hero 1, ...)

title: Decode a paw-ned2 team template
